acceptance.coverage: Real 3D branch traversal and controller journal. Complete native-engine routes use the supported 2D view for their remainder. Keyboard and standard Gamepad input samples plus normal UI controls; no player-position assignments, score assignments or forced native wins. Isolated fixtures and carried-state model runs are separate evidence, not native completions.
acceptance.paused_scene_test: At most one actual 3D renderer call over twelve animation frames with the challenge journal open. This is an invocation check, not a device frame-time benchmark.

publication.status: Awaiting master merge and public-byte verification; branch acceptance alone is not a published release.
